name: carnival-factory/north-pole
description: Factory skills specific to the North Pole map: assess a participant's booth request before the factory builds it, grant or decline an Elf Engineer badge request, accept or decline an advent challenge marked done, judge a booth pull request's risk and taste before it can merge on its own, and review booths and attractions against the house rules, review a square's craft, and welcome feedback, ideas and Year in Review answers.
